title: Flimsy closer
text:
Flimsy closer. I guess I didn't look hard enough at the picture. I though it was the regular Rubbermaid container.
This one has flimsy closer. I would definitely not put liquids in it.
But I will keep to put dry ingredients only. Do not put liquids the top is not secure
Has pretty flowers on the sides
Not what I wanted but for maybe cupcakes or dry ingredients only.
